subject: Future Tech
title: Simulation: Driving Billions of Miles
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Simulation: Driving Billions of Miles.

hook.text: Testing AVs on real roads is slow and dangerous.

buildup.text: Simulation models weather, pedestrians, other cars, and road conditions.

discovery.text: Waymo's Carcraft runs 25,000 virtual cars at once, covering 10 million miles per day in simulated driving.

climax.text: The best approach combines simulation with real-world testing.

punchline.text: A million virtual crashes so there are zero real ones.

quiz.question: How many simulated miles does Waymo's Carcraft cover daily?
